speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia. The combination of severe anemia (low hemoglobin), significant thrombocytopenia (low platelets), and marked leukocytosis (elevated WBC) with a normal reticulocyte count is highly characteristic of acute leukemia, not iron deficiency anemia. We must proceed immediately with a Peripheral Smear and Bone Marrow Biopsy to confirm the cell type.
